## Goal

Make the promise that a published analysis cannot change hold at the database level, for every part of it that the public record depends on.

## Context

Publication-time immutability is enforced by database triggers and covered by tests, but the independent review found the guarantee incomplete: some relations and some historically meaningful values can still change after publication, and one correction path can alter a settled outcome without leaving a complete audit trail. Details are in the owner's private tracker. This package must land before a real track record is published.

## Scope

- New migrations that close the gaps at the database level, covering the relations and the values the public record depends on, with consistent locking at publication.
- Freeze the values the public record depends on at publication, either as an immutable snapshot or by locking the source fields.
- Model a legitimate correction as an added record carrying reason, author and the previous value, written in the same transaction as the change it describes.
- Database tests for every new invariant, in the style of the existing ones.
- `docs/DATABASE.md` updated to state the guarantee that now actually holds.

## Out of scope

- Changing how results are computed.
- Changing public pages (SC-024).
- Editing any committed migration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each new invariant has a database test that fails without the migration and passes with it.
- [ ] An attempt to change a published analysis through the ordinary interface, through a privileged path and through direct SQL is refused or recorded, as the design states.
- [ ] A correction produces a complete, attributable trail.
- [ ] `pnpm test:db` passes in full and the count is reported.
- [ ] Independent review by Codex approves the migrations and the tests. The author does not approve its own work.

## Required tests

- New DB tests per invariant.
- `pnpm test:db` in full.
- All standard checks.

## Dependencies

- SC-022

P1 · Phase A
